turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Why am I here, Hale? The zero on Owen's essay went in before anyone called me.
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Which is the one thing I came about. Go on.
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
I'm not in your chair, Hale. Take the zero off and tell me what you have.
